feature: Passkey access to encrypted saved links and explicit privacy information

validation.localUnsupportedPrf: rejected before any profile or passkey persistence; supported retry passed
validation.bothContainerReplacements: encrypted profiles, records and passkey envelopes identical before and after

boundaries: Browser-native WebAuthn tested with Chromium virtual CTAP2 PRF authenticator; physical biometrics and cross-device provider sync were not tested.
Passkey-provider PRF support varies; MonliPay cannot reset a lost passkey.
Legacy keys remain usable on migrated profiles. New users never receive a manual recovery-key setup.
No contract deployment or onchain transaction for this release.
Saved claim secrets are encrypted; wallet addresses, amounts and transactions remain public. Contacts do not use this client-side encryption.
Anonymous payments are not implemented. Murk is a feasibility candidate, not an integrated or endorsed provider.
Existing Cloudflare analytics injection remains blocked by CSP; no relaxation added.
